sloka: तमुवाच महातेजाः पौलस्त्यमपराजितम्।समाह्वये त्वां समरे सम्यग्युद्धं प्रयच्छ मे ।। ६.८७.९ ।।
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejāḥ paulastyamaparājitam।samāhvaye tvāṁ samare samyagyuddhaṁ prayaccha me ।। 6.87.9 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana of extraordinary energy, spoke to Indrajith of the Paulastya clan," I challenge you to fight in battle directly. Fight with me."
